rigs drug bar do dang bcas pa rnams la yang ma la bsgom pa ji lta bar rim bzhin bsgom/ gnas skabs 'ga' zhig tu rang gi lus la na tsha'am/ sems la sdug bsngal drag po byung na de lam du bya ba'i phyir 'di ltar bsam ste/ 'jig rten gyi khams na bdag ltar du na tsha dang sdug bsngal drag pos nyam thag pa du ma yod nges/ de thams cad snying re rje/ de rnams kyi sdug bsngal thams cad bdag gi lus 'di'i steng du smin par gyur cig ces brjod cing len pa'i dmigs pa bsgom/ bdag gi bde dge thams cad de rnams la smin par gyur cig brjod cing gtong ba'i dmigs pa sngar ltar bsgom/ de bzhin du dmyal ba la tsha grang gis sdug bsngal ba dang*/ yi dwags bkres skom gyis sdug bsngal ba sogs la yang sngar gyi rigs 'gros sbyar nas gtong len bsgom/ mthar brje ba'i yul sems can dang*/ brje ba po rang nyid dang*/ brje bya bde sdug gces 'dzin dang bcas pa don dam gshis lugs la cir yang grub pa med mod/ kun rdzob tu sems 'khrul pa'i dbang gis med bzhin du snang ba 'di lta bu la longs spyod dgos pa snying re rje snyam pa dang*/ brje ba'i yul gyi sems can 'di rnams kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang myur du thob par gyur cig snyam du bsams la/ dge ba bsngo/ /'di dag gi skabs su sngon thub pa chen po mdza' bo'i bu mor 'khrungs pa'i gtam rgyud sogs dang*/ bdag gzhan brje ba bsgom rigs pa'i rgyu mtshan/ bsgom pa'i phan yon/ ma bsgoms pa'i nyes dmigs rnams spyod 'jug las byung ba rnams ci rigs par bshad do/ /gsum pa de dag spyod pa la bslab pa la/ rgyal sras kyi spyod pa spyi la bslab pa/ rang smin byed phar phyin drug la bslab pa/ gzhan smin byed bsdu dngos bzhi la bslab pa'i tshul lo/ /de dag kyang phyogs gcig tu brjod na rang don yid byed kyi bsam pa 'di dor nas bdag gi lus longs spyod dus gsum du bsags pa'i dge rtsa thams cad sems can la btang bar bgyi'o snyam du bsam zhing ngag tu yang*/

lus dang de bzhin longs spyod dang*/ /dus gsum dge ba'i dngos po rnams/ /sems can kun gyi don bsgrub phyir/ /'phangs pa med par gtang bar bya/ /zhes brjod/ de ltar btang ba la brten nas sems can zas 'dod pa rnams la zas/ skom 'dod pa rnams la skom/ dbul zhing phongs pa rnams la mi zad pa'i gter/ nad pa rnams la sman dang nad g.yog /chos 'dod pa rnams la chos ston pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen/ brgal 'dod pa rnams la gru dang gzings dang zam pa/ lam zhugs rnams la ded dpon/ mgon med pa rnams la mgon/ skyabs med pa rnams la skyabs/ dpung gnyen med pa la dpung gnyen sogs mdor na sems can so so'i mdun du gang 'dod pa'i longs spyod kyi dngos po zad mi shes pa 'byung bar gyur cig snyam du bsam/ de bzhin du rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa rnams kyis rang gzhan gyi don rgya chen po bsgrub pa'i phyir bdog pa'i dngos po gzhan la gtong ba sbyin pa/ gzhan la gnod pa'i kha na ma tho ba spong ba tshul khrims/ gzhan gyis gnod pa la sems mi 'khrugs pa bzod pa/ dge ba la sems spro ba brtson 'grus/ dge ba'i dmigs pa la sems rtse gcig pa bsam gtan/ chos rab tu rnam par 'byed pa shes rab ste pha rol tu phyin pa drug dang*/ zang zing gi sbyin pas chos kyi ched du 'khor bsdu ba dang*/ snyan par smra bas pha rol mgu bar byas nas snod dang 'tshams par chos bstan pa dang*/ chos thos pa de nyams su len pa la thabs mkhas kyis 'jug pa don spyod pa dang*/ gzhan nyams len la gzhug pa'i ched du rang nyid kyang chos nyams su len pa la 'bad brtsol gyis 'jug pa don mthun pa ste/ bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi la bslab cing thugs nyams su bzhes pa ltar/ bdag gis kyang rang smin byed phar phyin drug dang*/ gzhan smin byed bsdu dngos bzhi la bslabs te/ sems can thams cad la phan bde bsam gyis mi khyab pa bsgrub par bgyi'o snyam du bsams zhing de ltar gyur na dga' ba'i blo bskyed/

dge ba bsngo zhing theg pa chen po'i smon lam gdab bo/ /dmigs khrid du skyong rgyu 'di tsam gyis 'thus la/ zhib tu spro bar 'dod na sbyin sogs kyi phan yon/ sbyin sogs re re la yon tan bzhi bsgrub pa/ chags pa bdun spang ba/ bsdu ba'i dngos bzhi'i bshad pa rnams mdo dang*/ rin chen phreng ba dang*/ mdo sde rgyan dang thub pa dgongs gsal las 'byung ba rnams ji ltar 'tshams par bshad do/ / gsum pa don dam byang sems bsgom pa la/ don dam byang chub sems kyi ngo bo bshad/ de nyid rgyud la skye ba'i thabs dngos bshad/ thabs de ji ltar nyams su blang ba'i tshul dang gsum/ dang po ni/ mgon po klu sgrub kyis/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi byang chub sems/ /bdag dang phung sogs rnam rig gi /rtog pa rnams kyis ma bsgribs pa/ /rtag tu stong nyid mtshan nyid bzhed/ /ces gsungs pa ltar phyi rol pas btags pa'i bdag dang*/ nyan thos sde gnyis kyis btags pa'i phung khams skye mched dang*/ sems tsam pas btags pa'i rnam rig ste/ shes pa bden par 'dod pa la sogs pa'i mthar 'dzin can gyi rtog pa rnams kyis ma bsgribs/ ma bslad pa sems kyi rang bzhin spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba'i gnas lugs stong pa nyid ni 'dir bsgom rgyu'i don dam byang sems kyi ngo bo yin te yul can gyi ming yul la btags so/ /gnyis pa de nyid rgyud la skye ba'i thabs ni/ rten zhi gnas dang brten pa lhag mthong gnyis yin te/ mdo dkon mchog sprin las/ zhi gnas gang zhe na sems rtse gcig pa'o/ /lhag mthong gang zhe na/ yang dag par so sor rtog pa'o/ /zhes dang*/ mdo rgyan las kyang*/ yang dag gnas pa la brten nas/ /sems la sems ni 'jog phyir dang*/ /chos rab rnam par 'byed pa'i phyir/ /zhi gnas dang ni lhag mthong brjod/ /ces so/ /gsum pa nyams su blang ba'i tshul la/ zhi gnas sgom pa/ lhag mthong sgom pa/ zung 'brel sgom pa'o/

/dang po ni/ spyod 'jug las/ zhi gnas rab tu ldan pa'i lhag mthong gis/ /nyon mongs rnam par 'joms par shes byas nas/ /thog mar zhi gnas btsal bya de yang ni/ /'jig rten chags pa med la mngon dgas 'grub/ /ces gsungs pas/ zhi gnas kyang lus sems dben pa la brten nas 'byung bas na thog mar 'jig rten gyi bya brel dang*/ zang zing gi nor dang*/ gnyen dang mdza' bshes sogs la chags pa'i rnam rtog thams cad spangs te/ rang nyid dben par gnas nas ting nge 'dzin bsgom par bya ste/ spyod 'jug las/ dben pa'i yon tan bsam byas nas/ /rnam rtog nye bar zhi ba dang*/ / byang chub sems ni bsgom par bya/ /zhes dang*/ rje btsun rin po ches/ pra ston zhus len las/ dben par gnas nas bsam gtan bsgom pa la/ /byis dang 'grogs na dben pa mi thob pas/ /skye bo dag la skyo ba bsgom bya ste/ /'di yis dben pa thob cing log 'tsho spong*/ /zhes so/ /de ltar dben par gnas nas zhi gnas bsgom pa la/ nyes pa lnga ngos zin par byas nas de spong ba'i gnyen po 'du byed brgyad brten te/ sems gnas pa'i thabs dgu'i sgo nas zhi gnas btsal dgos la/ de la nyes pa lnga ni/ dge ba'i dmigs pa la sems mi sbyor ba'i le lo dang*/ sbyor yang ting 'dzin bsgom pa'i gdams ngag brjed pa dang*/ ma brjed kyang sems mi gnas pa bying rgod dang*/ bying rgod du song ba shes kyang de spong ba'i gnyen po mi 'tshol ba 'du mi byed pa dang*/ ha cang gnyen po btsal drag pas sems mi gnas pa 'du byed pa rnams te/ dbus mtha' las/ le lo dang ni gdams ngag rnams/ /brjed dang bying dang rgod pa dang*/ /'du mi byed dang 'du byed de/ /'di dag nyes pa lngar 'dod do/ /zhes so/ /gnyen po 'du byed brgyad ni/ le lo'i gnyen por 'dun pa/ rtsol ba/ dad pa/ shin sbyangs dang bzhi/ de rnams kyi nang nas gtso bo ni rtsol ba ste/ 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs dran pa sogs kyi sgo nas le lo spangs nas ting nge 'dzin bsgom pa la brtson 'grus rtsom pa gal che/

gdams ngag brjed pa'i gnyen por dran shes bzhin bsten pa gal che ste/ ting 'dzin bsgom pa'i gdams ngag gi dmigs rnam gang yin pa de dran pas yid la byas nas shes bzhin gyis mi brjed par 'dzin pa'o/ /bying rgod ngos ma zin pa'i gnyen por ni/ bying rgod kyi dbang du song ma song rtog pa yin/ bying rgod sel ba'i thabs 'du mi byed pa'i gnyen po ni/ 'du byed pa ste gnyen po de rtsol bas ston pa yin/ 'du byas drag nas 'thor te sems mi gnas pa'i gnyen po ni/ 'du byed btang snyoms bsten pa yin te/ bsgrim lhod ran pas mnyam khad kyis gnas pa na ting nge 'dzin rnal ma zhig yong ba yin no/ /de skad du dbus mtha' las/ gnas dang de la gnas pa dang*/ /rgyu dang 'bras bu nyid du'o/ /dmigs pa brjed par ma gyur dang*/ / bying dang rgod dang rtog pa dang*/ /de spong mngon par 'du byed dang*/ /zhi tshe rnal du 'jug pa'o/ /zhes so/ /sems gnas par byed pa'i thabs dngos ni/ 'jog dang rgyun 'jog bslan te 'jog /nyer 'jog dul dang zhi bar byed/ /nyer zhi rtse gcig mnyam 'jog pa/ /'jog pa'i rim pa rnam dgu yin/ /zhes pa ltar dgu las/ dang po sems 'jog pa la dmigs rten mi g.yo ba/ lus mi 'gul ba/ rdzi ma mi 'khrab pa/ dmigs rten gyi rnam pa gsal ba dang bzhi dgos pa las/ dang po ni/ bdag gis sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas thob par bya/ de'i ched du sems rtse gcig pa'i ting nge 'dzin bsgom par bya/ /zhes sems bskyed nas/ sangs rgyas kyi sku ri mor bris pa la sogs pa mtshar zhing yid du 'ong ba la dmigs rten bya/ yang na me tog sngon po'am/ gos dar gyi ras ma sngon po la sogs pa gang rung zhig rang gi mdun du nye ring 'tshams pa zhig tu mi g.yo bar gzhag /lus mi 'gul ba ni/ mig ha cang mi dbye/ ha cang mi zum par sna'i rtse mor gtad cing lus drang por bsrang*/

phrag pa mnyam por bzhag la/ /mgo bo mi mtho mi dma' zhing*/ so dang mchu rang babs su bzhag cing*/ dbugs phyi nang du rgyu ba yang sgra can dang*/ rngam pa can dang*/ rgod bag can du mi gtong bar dal bu dal bus rgyu ru gzhug /de ltar drang zhing g.yo ba med pa'i tshul gyis 'jam pa'i stan la 'dug par bya/ rdzi ma mi 'khrab pa ni mig gi ya lcibs kyis mig 'bras kyi phyed tsam khebs par bkab la/ dmigs rten gyi steng du mig zim gyis blta zhing*/ mchi ma la sogs pa byung na lag pas mi reg par ci bder 'bab du bcug la/ zug rngu byung na de la sems mi gtod par dmigs rten gyi steng du drag tu gtad de gnas par bya/ dmigs rten gyi rnam pa gsal ba ni/ legs nyes la sogs pa cir yang mi rtog par rnam pa gang yin pa de nyid rtog med kyi shes pa la gsal seng nge ba'i tshul du 'char du bcug pa'o/ / rgyun du 'jog pa ni/ de lta bu dang po nyid nas yun ring po mi 'ong bas thung tsam rgyun mthud cing 'jog pa'o/ /bslan te 'jog pa ni/ rnam g.yeng byung na ngo shes par byas nas dmigs pa de nyid la sems slod pa'o/ /nye bar 'jog pa ni/ sems mi 'phro ba'i ched du dran pas sems dmigs pa'i steng du sdud pa'o/ / dul bar byed pa ni/ ting nge 'dzin gyi yon tan la sems spro ba'i sgo nas bying rgod byung na gnyen pos sems 'dul ba'o/ /zhi bar byed pa ni/ rnam g.yeng la sogs pa'i rkyen gyis sems mi dga' bar gyur na dmigs pa la sems gtad de zhi bar byed pa'o/ /nye bar zhi bar byed pa ni/ bsam gtan gyi mi mthun phyogs brnab sems la sogs pa skyes na de yang dmigs pa la sems gtad de zhi bar byed pa'o/ /rtse gcig tu 'jog pa ni/ bying rgod spang ba'i thabs 'dus byas pas kyang sems mi 'gro na rtog pa de nyid kyi steng du 'jog pa'o/ /shin tu mnyam par 'jog pa ni/ goms pa'i dbang gis 'bad rtsol mi dgos par ting nge 'dzin du rang gi ngang gis 'gyur ba ste/

de dag kyang mdo sde rgyan las/ dmigs pa la ni sems gtad nas/ /de rgyun rnam par g.yeng mi bya/ /rnam g.yeng myur du rtogs byas nas/ /de la slar yang bslan par bya/ /blo ldan gong nas gong du yang*/ /sems ni nang du bsdu bar bya/ /de nas yon tan mthong ba'i phyir/ /ting nge 'dzin la sems 'dul lo/ /rnam g.yeng nyes pa mthong ba'i phyir/ /de la mi dga' zhi bar byed/ /brnab sems yid mi bde la sogs/ /langs pa de bzhin zhi bar bya/ / de nas sdom brtson can gyis ni/ /sems ni mngon par 'du byed bcas/ /rang gi ngang gis 'byung ba thob/ /de goms pa las 'du mi byed/ /de nas de yi lus dang sems/ /shin tu sbyangs pa che thob nas/ /yid la byed dang bcas zhes bya/ / zhes so/ /de ltar bsgoms pas nyams dang po ri gzar gyi 'bab chu lta bu rnam rtog gi phreng ba gcig rjes la gcig 'byung ba ni rnam rtog ngos zin gyi nyams zhes bya ba yin/ nyams gnyis pa gcong rong dog mo'i 'bab chu lta bu rnam rtog nyal gyis zhi ba'i 'phro la thol gyis skyes yong*/ yang zhi 'gro ba sogs res 'jog tu 'byung ba ni rnam rtog ngal bso ba'i nyams yin/ nyams gsum pa lung pa phu gsum gyi rdzing chu lta bu rkyen gyis ma dkrugs pa'i tshe/ rnam rtog cher mi 'byung*/ rkyen gyis dkrugs pa na rnam rtog cher skyes te sems gnas pa la yang gnod par byed pa ni/ rnam rtog thang chad pa'i nyams yin/ nyams bzhi pa rgya mtsho rlabs dang bcas pa lta bu ni/ rnam rtog gi rba rlabs ci byung yang sems gnas pa la cher mi gnod cing rang shugs kyis myur du zhi 'gro ba ni rnam rtog 'du byed pa'i nyams yin/ nyams bzhi pa rgya mtsho rlabs dang bcas pa lta bu ni/ rnam rtog gi rba rlabs ci byung yang sems gnas pa la cher mi gnod cing rang shugs kyis myur du zhi 'gro ba ni rnam rtog 'du byed pa'i nyams yin/ nyams lnga pa rgya mtsho rlabs dang bral ba lta bu ni/

rnam rtog gi rba rlabs thams cad nyal gyis zhi nas sems rtse gcig tu khrig ge gnas pa ni rnam tog 'du mi byed pa'i nyams yin/ de ltar lnga pa de 'dod sems rtse gcig pa'i nyams yin pas/ da dung lnga pa de'i rgyun bskyangs pa las lus sems shin sbyangs kyi bde ba skyes pa na bsam gtan gyi sas bsdus kyi zhi gnas mtshan nyid par slab cing*/ 'dir lhag mthong bsgom pa'i rten la yang zhi gnas 'di byung na mchog yin no/ /gnyis pa lhag mthong bsgom pa la/ gsal ba ngos gzung ba/ mtha' bral la blo gzhag pa/ brjod bral la nges pa bskyed pa dang gsum/ dang po ni/ bdag gis sems can gyi don du sangs rgyas thob par bya/ de'i ched du bla ma dam pa'i man ngag la brten nas sems kyi gsang ba bla na med pa 'di khong du chud par bgyi'o snyam du sems bskyed la/ de yang rang gi phung po la dmigs nas bdag dang bdag gir 'dzin pa ni 'khrul pa kho na ste/ bdag ces bya ba yod na ming dang lus sems gang rung las ma 'das pa las/ ming ni glo bur du btags pa tsam yin pa'i phyir bdag ma yin/ lus ni sha khrag rus pa'i gong bu las btags pa'i phyir dang*/ spyi bo nas rkang mthil gyi bar gyi phyi nang gang du yang bdag ma dmigs pas na lus bdag ma yin/ sems ni 'das pa ni 'gags/ ma 'ongs pa ni ma skyes/ da ltar ba ni de ma thag 'gag par 'gyur bas na bdag ma yin/ de bas na bdag go snyam pa ni gzhi med la 'khrul pa kho na'o/ /phyi rol gyi ri rab khang khyim la sogs pa 'di dag kun kyang*/ phywa dang dbang phyug dang*/ 'byung bzhi'i rdul phran la sogs pa byed pa po gzhan gyis byas pa ma yin gyi/ rang sems 'khrul pa'i bag chags kyis bslad pa'i snang ba tsam ste rmi lam gyi grong khyer rta glang sogs dang kun tu mtshungs pa'o/ /gzung ba ma grub pa'i phyir 'dzin pa'ang ma grub la/ de bas na gzung 'dzin gnyis bral gyi sems gsal tsam rig tsam de'i ngang la ma yengs par yun ji tsam gnas kyi bar du 'jog

/ gnyis pa ni/ de ltar gnas pa'i tshe gsal tsam rig tsam zhig nyams su myong ba na/ sems de nyid thog mar gang las skyes brtags pas/ skye ba'i rgyu ma rnyed pas skye med du stong sang nge ba/ bar du gang du gnas bltas pas kha dog dbyibs la sogs pa gang du yang ma grub cing*/ lus kyi phyi nang gang du yang ma rnyed pas gnas med du dwangs sang nge ba/ mtha' mar gang du 'gag bltas pas gang du yang mi 'gag pas na 'gags med du bde cham me ba/ de ltar skye 'gag gnas gsum dang bral bas stong nyid du rjen ne ba/ myong rig tu gsal tsam rig tsam/ gsal ba'i dus nyid na stong pa/ stong pa'i dus na gsal ba'i rgyun ma 'gags pa'i gsal stong 'dzin med/ mtha' bral ris med/ brjod bral blo 'das ngang la hrig ge /rjen ni/ ye re gzhag /tha na brjod bral tsam du'ang 'dzin pa med par had de chad de gzhag /gsum pa brjod bral la nges par bskyed pa ni/ de ltar bsgom bya'i rnal 'byor/ sgom byed kyi thabs/ sgom mkhan gsum ka yang rang bzhin gyis ma grub pa ngo bo 'di zhes brjod du med cing blo'i yul las 'das pa de'i ngang la gzhag/ thun mtshams su yang snang ba'i chos thams cad chos kyi dbyings kyi rang gzugs dang rang mdangs yin par blta'o/ /'di dag ni rje btsun rin po ches/ sems dang po skye ba med pa la/ gnas pa dang 'gag pa ga la srid/ skye 'gag med par bsam pa yang*/ /rnam rtog yin gyis zhog la thong*/ /bzhag pa rang yang zhog la thong*/ /'jog mkhan rang yang rnam rtog yin/ /zhes dang*/ gsal ba ma 'gags stong pa de/ /zung 'jug gi gnas lugs yin par go /zhes gsungs pa rnams kyi don ni nyams len dmigs par dril ba'o/ /gsum pa zung 'brel bsgom pa ni/ de lta bu'i lhag mthong gi shes rab dang de nyid sngar gyi zhi gnas kyi steng du bsgoms la/ gnas cha che na shes rab kyi ngar bskyed/ shes rab ngar ches bas sems mi gnas na lhod kyis glod pas zung 'brel du 'gyur ro/

/gnyis pa skye 'gyur gyi nyams la nges shes bsgom pa ni/ spyir sngags lam du skye 'gyur gyi nyams la bsam gyis mi khyab kyang bsdu na bco lnga ste/ lam gsum nyams gsum drod gsum rten 'brel gsum/ /ting 'dzin gsum ste lnga gsum bco lnga'o/ /zhes pa ltar las lam gsum ni/ 'jug pa sel ba'i lam/ chags pa gcod pa'i lam/ byang chub chen po'i lam/ nyams gsum ni lus nyams/ sems nyams/ rmi nyams/ drod gsum ni/ rnam rtog sngon song gi drod/ khams dgu 'dus pa'i drod/ thig le 'bar zhing brtan pa'i drod/ rten 'brel gsum ni/ rlug log gi rten 'brel/ /mthong snang gi rten 'brel/ rmi lam gyi rten 'brel/ ting 'dzin gsum ni/ mtshan nyid sna tshogs pa'i ting 'dzin/ /rang bzhin stong pa'i ting 'dzin/ / ngo bo cung 'jug gi ting 'dzin no/ /snying po nyams len ni/ /bdag gis sems can gyi don du sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob pa'i ched du zab mo rdo rje theg pa'i lam la 'jug par bgyi'o/ /der zhugs nas so so'i nyams rgyud la skyes skyes kyi bar du nyams su blang bar bgyi/ nyams su blangs pas nyams bzang ngan ci skyes pa thams cad kyang chos bzhin du byung rgyal du bskyang bar bgyi'o snyam du bsgom/ gsum pa spro ba bskyed pa dag pa'i snang ba'i khrid ni/ gzhung las bde bar gshegs pa la sku gsung thugs mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo la dag pa'i snang ba zhes pas bstan/ de la sku mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo la gnyis las/ sku'i gsang ba bsam gyi mi khyab pa ni/ sangs rgyas kyi dbu'i gtsug tor ltar mi mngon pa ste/ sngon byang chub sems dpa' shugs 'chang gis bcom ldan 'das kyi dbu'i gtsug tor gyi mtha' rtogs par 'dod nas ri rab kyi steng dang*/ sum cu rtsa gsum dang*/ tshangs pa'i 'jig rten du phyin kyang mtha' ma mthong*/ de bzhin du steng phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams bye ba phrag brgya 'das pa na 'jig rten gyi khams padmo can zhes bya ba na de bzhin gshegs pa padmo'i dpal gyi snying po'i rgyal po bzhugs pa'i sa rnams su rim gyis phyin te bltas kyang dbu'i gtsug tor gyi mtha' ma mthong ba lta bu'o/

/sku thams cad pa ni rgyal ba mchog nas bzung ste ri bong dang stag dang seng ge dang gzings dang zam pa la sogs pa gdul bya gang la gang gis 'dul ba de dang rjes su 'tshams pa'i skur bstan nas don mdzad pa'o/ /gsung la'ang gnyis las gsung gi gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa ni/ sangs rgyas kyi gsung nye ring dang bral ba ste/ drung du nyan kyang che ba med la/ dpag tshad dang rgyang grags la sogs pa nas nyan kyang chung ba med de/ de yang mo'u 'gal gyi bus nub phyogs bde ba can dang*/ de nas kyang 'jig rten gyi khams bye ba khrag brgya 'das pa na 'od zer can gyi 'jig rten gyi khams yod pas sa der byon te nyan pas kyang chung ba med pa thos pa lta bu'o/ /gsung thams cad pa ni/ lha'i skad nas bzung ste klu dang gnod sbyin dang*/ srin po la sogs pa 'gro ba so so'i skad du chos ston nus pa'o/ / thugs la'ang gnyis/ thugs kyi gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa ni/ gdul bya'i khams dang bsam pa dang*/ bag la nyal rnams sangs rgyas kyis mkhyen pa bzhin gzhan sus kyang mi mkhyen pa ste/ mo'u 'gal gyi bus rang gi ma gang du skyes ma mkhyen pa bcom ldan 'das kyis mkhyen pa dang*/ khyim bdag dpal skyes la thar pa'i sa bon yod pa 'khor dgra bcom pa sus kyang ma mkhyen pas rab tu 'byung ma nus pa las/ ston pas dpal skyes skye ba bdun gyi gong rol du khyir skyes pa na phag gis bdas nas mchod rten zhig la bskor ba byas pas thar pa'i sa bon yod par mkhyen nas rab tu 'byung bar gnang ste khos kyang phyis dgra bcom pa thob pa lta bu'o/ /thugs thams cad pa ni/ shes bya ji lta ba dang ji snyed pa mkhyen pa ste/ de yang ji lta ba mkhyen pa ni/ chos thams cad kyi gnas lugs de bzhin nyid mkhyen cing mngon du gyur pa nyid dang*/ ji snyed pa mkhyen pa ni/ rma bya'i mdongs ni gcig pu la/ /rgyu yi dbye ba ji snyed pa/ /kun mkhyen min pas shes bya min/
